clips.title: The story
paras: Camp Taurajo is a quiet tauren settlement nestled in the southern Barrens, sitting right along the mountain pass leading west into Mulgore. It serves as a vital frontier haven, offering tired wanderers an inn, supplies, profession mentors, and wind rider transit between the plains and central Kalimdor.

Situated at the eastern mouth of the pass to Mulgore, Camp Taurajo is often the first glimpse of the wider Barrens seen by young tauren venturing out from Bloodhoof Village. Surrounded by dry scrubland and rugged mesas, the camp operates as both an outpost and a trading hub. It shelters hunters, leathercrafters, and field herbalists while maintaining wind rider connections to Thunder Bluff, the Crossroads, and Freewind Post deeper south.
